title: Psychic medium explains the voice in the witch encounter as a guardian angel
summary: Brent tells of Psychic medium explains the voice in the witch encounter as a guardian angel, about last year (c. 2025), about the earlier encounter at Los Angeles bungalow (the encounter), and relays what a named person told them. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: "Oh, that was your that was your guardian angel or your higher self or whatever you want to call it talking to you."

plain: A man named Brent tells of a frightening encounter with what he calls a witch in a bungalow in Los Angeles, during which he heard a voice. He says that around 2025 a friend of his who is a psychic medium, someone who claims to talk with spirits, told him the voice was his guardian angel or his higher self speaking to him. If true, it would mean someone or something was looking out for him that night.
